create_UntypedStorage: create an UntypedStorage with a given size and optional device
share_UntypedStorage_memory: share an UntypedStorage across processes using shared memory
create_TypedStorage: create a TypedStorage with a specific dtype and optional device
cast_TypedStorage_dtype: cast a TypedStorage to a different dtype such as float or double
load_UntypedStorage_from_file: load an UntypedStorage from a memory-mapped file with optional sharing
